title: The Salary Illusion
hook: Your annual hike is actually a pay cut.
script:
(Visual: Split screen. Left side shows a 10% salary increase. Right side shows a graph of inflation, rent, and lifestyle creep.)
Most Indian professionals celebrate a 10% hike as "growth." But let's look at the math.
If inflation is at 6% and your lifestyle expenses grew by 5% because you moved to a better apartment or bought a better car to match your new title... you haven't gained wealth.
You've just increased your tax bracket while your purchasing power stayed flat.
You aren't earning more; you're just spending more to look like you're earning more.
The trap isn't the salary—it's the belief that a higher number equals more freedom.
True growth isn't the percentage on your appraisal letter; it's the gap between your income and your ego.
caption: The bigger the paycheck, the bigger the trap. Stop measuring success by your gross salary and start measuring it by your autonomy. 📉💸 #RationalThoughts #CareerGrowth #FinancialLiteracy #CorporateIndia #FirstPrinciples
